2608.18936.title: Graphical Design of Interpretable Architectures
2608.18936.paper_summary: Designing, implementing, and comparing interpretable architectures requires a formal language to represent them. The most common representations fall short in one of two ways. Symbolic equations give no global view of an architecture at a glance. Probabilistic graphical models and flowcharts do not describe actual tensor manipulations, thus hiding key insights and limiting reproducibility. To close this gap, we introduce a graphical notation for designing interpretable AI architectures, adapted from Penrose tensor notation. This graphical notation gives a global view of an architecture and maps one to one onto PyTorch einsum code. We first use this notation to describe architectures that are interpretable by construction, including concept bottlenecks, sparse probes, prototype networks, neural additive models, and mixtures of linear models. We then diagram the key architectural components of Steerling-8B, a frontier interpretable language model. The diagram yields global insights into the architecture (e.g., showing that Steerling is a residual model), a geometric interpretation of each individual operation, and a direct translation into 33 lines of PyTorch code.
2608.18936.paper_summary_zh: 設計、實施和比較可解釋的架構需要一種正式的語言來表示它們。最常見的表示法在兩個方面之一上都顯得不足。符號方程式無法一目了然地提供架構的全局視圖。概率圖模型和流程圖無法描述實際的張量操作，因此隱藏了關鍵見解並限制了可重現性。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了一種圖形符號，用於設計可解釋的 AI 架構，這種符號改編自 Penrose 張量符號。這種圖形符號提供了架構的全局視圖，並與 PyTorch einsum 代碼一對一映射。我們首先使用這種符號來描述從本質上可解釋的架構，包括概念瓶頸、稀疏探針、原型網絡、神經加法模型和線性模型的混合。然後，我們為 Steerling-8B 的關鍵架構組件繪製圖表，這是一個前沿的可解釋語言模型。該圖表提供了對架構的全局見解（例如，顯示 Steerling 是一個殘差模型）、每個單獨操作的幾何解釋，以及直接轉換為 33 行 PyTorch 代碼。
